legends.token_attention: Frozen token-attention readouts on1024 disjoint test molecules; arithmetic mean of3 seed logits. Panels a,b show macro AUROC with1000 paired molecule bootstrap95% intervals. Panel c is latest minus parent, paired on identical molecules. Fixed shared145MACCS and13functional-group targets (≥5 positives/negatives in train/test); rare-target undefined resamples are excluded with the target set fixed. Depth19 is raw; final is native state27. Scores are chemical accessibility under this readout, not fragment annotations.
legends.token_geometry: Existing descriptive native physical-token geometry over6144 panel molecules. Effective rank uses a shared256-dimensional random projection and at most8 fixed quantile physical peaks per molecule. Input m/z R² uses7953 held-out sampled tokens with train/validation split by molecule. States26/27 are final norm/output. Geometry and input reconstruction are not direct chemical semantics; no confidence intervals are claimed.
legends.sae_reconstruction: Panel a: raw19 TopK SAE held-out fraction of variance explained relative to the training mean; equal molecule weighting,8192dictionary features, three configurations per encoder. Seed1 changes initialization, training order and sampled physical tokens; k64/seed0 shares the k32/seed0 sampled tokens. Individual fits are points, not independent repeated experiments. Panel b: full SAE reconstruction replacement changes frozen-readout balanced BCE on512 test molecules;2000 paired molecule bootstrap95% intervals. High reconstruction quality does not imply chemical interpretability or harmless replacement.
legends.chemical_features: Held-out1024-molecule AUROC averaged over both fixed train/validation-selected SAE features per concept. Feature IDs were frozen before test confirmation; no test-best feature is chosen. Error bars are1000 paired molecule bootstrap95% intervals, conditional on dictionary and selected features. Nitrile failures retained; amine had no qualifying feature and is not plotted. Sparse-feature associations are not monosemanticity or measured fragment identity.
legends.feature_stability: For each primary feature, align a control-dictionary feature by highest training molecule-max Spearman without chemical labels, then measure held-out test activation Spearman. Points average the two frozen primary features per concept; no uncertainty interval or independent-run population claim. Seed1 and k64/seed0 have distinct perturbations described in reconstruction legend. Latest hydroxyl primary features share one aligned control feature in both controls; replication need not imply two independent mechanisms or chemistry.
legends.sae_causal: All10 frozen features per encoder, dose1 error-preserving SAE direction edits on512 test molecules. Points show target-logit effect of feature ablation minus a control with the same REQUESTED per-token edit L2 before bfloat16 rounding: firing/RMS-matched dictionary direction or random orthogonal direction. Realized norms match approximately; some median mismatches are3–4% and latest-checkpoint tails reach7–8%. Negative means less target evidence than control.2000 paired molecule bootstrap95% intervals are unadjusted; the40-test family is documented in original analysis. Off-target effects, nuisance features and failed nitrile associations remain; no claim of isolated chemical mechanisms or molecule counterfactuals.
legends.chemical_neighbors: Label-free cosine nearest training molecule using molecular maxima over8192 token-SAE features. Panels a,b show1024-query full-bank and472-query matched-bank chemical similarities; the matched bank requires≥2candidates with identical instrument/adduct/CEpresence and≤5Da precursor,10rawCE,5peak-count gaps. Panel c shows paired latest-minus-parent Morgan differences with1000 molecule bootstrap95% intervals. Labels only score neighbors. The matched subset has404queries with no candidate and148 with only one; support restriction and residual confounding limit inference.
legends.component_heads: Panel a: test balanced-BCE change after ablating the validation-top-ranked attention, MLP or metadata branch for each encoder; selection used256validation molecules, confirmation512test molecules. Bars are2000 paired molecule bootstrap95% intervals. Panels b,c show all8 individual heads in each of3validation-selected attention blocks; colors are point estimates with a common scale. Branch and head perturbation sizes differ, so magnitude is not a normalized causal ranking. Block IDs are1-based; head IDs are0-based. Negative BCE change is improvement.
legends.activation_rescue: After attenuating the highest-intensity20% of physical peaks to10%, replace clean raw activations at the affected slots or an equal number of uncorrupted random slots, for every native raw depth0–25. Curves show selected-minus-random logit-MSE reduction and balanced-BCE recovery on256test molecules; shaded bands are2000 paired molecule bootstrap95% intervals. Output-distance rescue is stronger than chemical-loss evidence; no test-selected best-layer claim. Full-state restoration matches clean predictions bitwise.
legends.input_robustness: 1024test molecules,177train-supported chemical targets, three frozen attentive heads ensembled in score space. Panels show unweighted BCE change and absolute sigmoid-score drift with2000 paired molecule bootstrap95% intervals. Attenuation retains slots/validity and multiplies selected intensity by0.1; removal changes validity; random controls match counts. m/z jitter±0.01Da and shift+0.1Da are artificial/OOD perturbations, preserving physical slots. These score-based metrics are not calibrated probabilities or embedding invariance.
legends.metadata_effects: 689same-molecule observed-repeat pairs with matching instrument/adduct and changed measured collision energy. Panel a compares CE-only metadata replacement, observed spectrum+ownCE, and observed spectrum+anchorCE against the anchor. Panel b changes measured CE on a fixed spectrum through final affine, internal blocks, or both; native diagonal shams are bitwise exact. Unweighted ensemble BCE across177targets;2000 paired molecule bootstrap95% intervals. Measured repeats can change spectra; metadata replacement is a computational intervention, not a molecule counterfactual.
legends.halide_case: Illustrative latest-encoder raw19 SAE feature7363, from the already-frozen feature atlas. The positive molecule and false positive are exactly the highest-activating test examples in their true-label classes, selected after confirmation, not new unseen evidence or a matched pair. Structures highlight molecular halogen atoms only. Grey lines are native selected measured peaks with transformed input intensity; orange lines are actual SAE activation at exact physical peak slots. Highest-activation peak annotated; no peak-to-fragment ground truth is asserted. Cohort testAUROC.675, matched donor ordering.649; counterexamples show imperfect specificity.
